name: PlantLeafBench
description: A comprehensive benchmark evaluating transfer-learning performance of domain-specific models for plant leaf disease classification across open datasets.
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark used in agricultural computer-vision research; well-regarded within the plant-disease detection community but not widely used outside it.
notes: Transfer-learning benchmark for leaf disease classification; may suffer from dataset imbalance and varying image quality across constituent datasets. Non-LLM vision benchmark; risk of dataset overlap/contamination between public sources.
